name: tidewater
description: KOZMOS Tidewater: the live diff of the current turn as tides above the prompt. Every file Claude edits gets its own pool of rolling waves, a green swell for added lines and a red ebb for removed ones, with file chips and totals like '+128 −42 · 6 files'. From the first edit of a turn until the next prompt. /tidewater toggles it.
